content: {"reasoning": "Prior authorization is REQUIRED for CPT 93229 and none is on file, so any submission now (with or without records) would draw an automatic CO-197 no-auth denial. Silverbridge offers neither a retroactive authorization window nor peer-to-peer review, so request_retro_auth and request_peer_to_peer would be rule violations, and appeal_with_necessity is unavailable with no denial on the table. Billing the patient or writing off is inappropriate with 147 days of timely filing left and a payable service. With no compliant action that can properly advance the claim, the touch belongs with the human specialist to pursue an authorization exception/backdated auth with the plan.", "action": "escalate"}
